title: Jump Game
description:
You stand at position `0` of a list `nums`. From position `i` you may jump forward by any number of steps from `1` up to `nums[i]`. A value of `0` means you cannot move on from that position.

Return `true` if you can reach the last position, and `false` otherwise.

### Constraints

- `1 <= nums.size() <= 5000`
- `0 <= nums[i] <= 1000`
- Inputs are passed as function arguments and the answer is returned from the function. Do not read from standard input or print the result.

examples.explanation: Jump 1 step to position 1, whose value 3 is enough to jump straight to the last position.
Every path arrives at position 3, whose value is 0. From there no jump is possible, so the last position cannot be reached.
